title: Case 017: Delivery notification contains an unusable tracking link

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: A notification points to a malformed path. Support must provide the correct shipment reference without asking the customer to follow an unknown link.
initial_request: The tracking link in my notification does not open. Please give me the correct way to find this parcel in the order portal.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask carrier support to provide the correct tracking reference through the verified customer channel.

outcome: The customer confirms access to the correct shipment tracking page.
boundaries: Tracking access is not delivery. No live URL or credentials are provided.

events.body: DL-017 notification path was truncated by our template. The account-linked notification belongs to this recipient; the shipment reference itself is intact in our order record.
The tracking link in my notification does not open. Please give me the correct way to find this parcel in the order portal.
Please send Vela the correct DL-017 tracking reference and portal navigation through the verified order thread. Do not send a payment request or ask for credentials.

events.to: Vela Morn, recipient; Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: In your existing order portal choose Shipments, then enter DL-017. The corrected notification uses https://tracking.ploverarc.example/shipments/DL-017. This exercise URL is inert; the fictional portal record is the source.
Using Shipments and reference DL-017, I can now see the right parcel and its depot status.
